description: Header file defining the ByteReader class for reading various data types and encodings in DWARF debugging information, including endianness, address sizes, and exception handling data.

classes.name: ByteReader
classes.description: A class for reading multi-byte values, LEB128 numbers, and encoded pointers from DWARF data, supporting different endianness and address sizes.

methods.name: ReadOneByte
methods.description: Reads a single byte from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadTwoBytes
methods.description: Reads two bytes respecting the endianness.

methods.name: ReadFourBytes
methods.description: Reads four bytes and returns as uint64.

methods.name: ReadEightBytes
methods.description: Reads eight bytes and returns as uint64.

methods.name: ReadUnsignedLEB128
methods.description: Reads an unsigned LEB128 number.

methods.name: ReadSignedLEB128
methods.description: Reads a signed LEB128 number.

methods.name: SetAddressSize
methods.description: Sets the address size (4 or 8 bytes).

methods.name: AddressSize
methods.description: Returns the current address size.

methods.name: ReadAddress
methods.description: Reads an address respecting endianness and address size.

methods.name: ReadInitialLength
methods.description: Reads a DWARF initial length and sets offset size.

methods.name: ReadOffset
methods.description: Reads an offset respecting endianness and offset size.

methods.name: OffsetSize
methods.description: Returns the current offset size.

methods.name: SetOffsetSize
methods.description: Sets the offset size (4 or 8 bytes).

methods.name: SetCFIDataBase
methods.description: Sets base info for exception handling data.

methods.name: SetTextBase
methods.description: Sets base address for the .text section.

methods.name: SetDataBase
methods.description: Sets base address for data-relative pointers.

methods.name: SetFunctionBase
methods.description: Sets base address for function-relative pointers.

methods.name: ClearFunctionBase
methods.description: Clears the function base address.

methods.name: ValidEncoding
methods.description: Checks if a pointer encoding is valid.

methods.name: UsableEncoding
methods.description: Checks if the encoding can be used with current base info.

methods.name: ReadEncodedPointer
methods.description: Reads an encoded pointer according to the specified encoding.
